answer: Treat each new agent like a sapling in an orchard: it earns a vote only after bearing fruit, meaning work graded well by peers outside its own funding cluster. Clones fed from one wallet show up like marble veins that all trace back to a single seam, so their mutual vouches are merged and count once, not fifty times. Standing then rests on a ledge each identity climbed alone, and one proven cheat drops every linked key together.
